eğlenать IBOutlet which is a bit odd. The IBOutlet seems to be duplicate or improperly set up. Now I'll ensure the IBOutlet is correctly set up for the bar chart view.

 I mainly want to know the positions of the bars of one axis which have the maximum "height" when we exclude the bars of other axis. The prefix of the bars of the other axis indicates the orientation (is bar pointing left or right). As for the position of the bars, should it be according to the frequency of data of the axis or in sorted order?

 איכותי

 איכותי

 איכותי
 
 Qualitative and Quantitative data both describe different types of information.

 Однако, for quantitative data, we only want the frequencies of data that are not excluded by other axis. The visual axis indicated which bars belong to specific axis or all in one axis and are not excluded. For example, for bar axis 1, if the bar starts from (0,5) with height 5, visual axis says that bar starts from x=0. How can it help us?

So, I'll update the code to reflect the explanation given above.

- Only the positions of the bars of one axis get sorted by frequencies when they are not excluded by other axis.
- The visual axis will indicate the bars are start from x=0 when the bar starts from (0,5) with height 5.
- In other words, when bar doesn't have x=0 at start, it should be placed in sorted order instead and have associated visual axis.
